intro: Which OKX account Atlas trades on. Live means real money.
notReady0: Not ready yet: no check passes.
notReady1: Not ready yet: 1 of 8 checks passes.
notReady: Not ready yet: {{n}} of 8 checks pass.
noKey: Add a live key in Connections first.
backAny: You can switch back at any time.
why0: Every check below has to pass first. None do yet.
why1: Every check below has to pass first. 1 of 8 does.
why: Every check below has to pass first. {{n}} of 8 do.
allReady: All eight checks pass. Switching asks for your password and a typed confirmation.
month: Your first live month runs until {{date}}. Autonomy stays at 2 or below, and a bot capital cap is required.
monthDone: Your first live month ended on {{date}}.
preNote: Atlas checks all eight again on its server when you press Switch to live.

i.live_connection: Live OKX key tested, with withdrawals off
i.live_autonomy: Live autonomy at level 2 or below
i.ip_allowlist: The live key only works from this Mac’s IP address
i.sub_account: The live key belongs to a sub-account only Atlas uses

a.ip_allowlist: In OKX, the key’s IP allow-list holds only this Mac’s address, so the key is useless anywhere else.
a.sub_account: A sub-account keeps the money Atlas trades apart from the rest of your OKX funds.
a.demo_reviewed: You’ve looked at how the demo did, in {{perf}} and the {{journal}}.

c.approve: Every Approve asks you once more, and names the real order it will send.
c.month: For the first 30 days, autonomy stays at 2 or below, and a bot capital cap is required.
c.telegram: Telegram can reject a live trade, but only Atlas can approve one.
c.pause: Trading pauses after every switch, until you resume it.
c.stop: Stop trading works the same: one press, and every stop stays on OKX.

sumTitle: All eight checks passed before the switch
sumBody: Atlas checks them again before every switch to live.

sw.title: Switch Atlas to live?
sw.text: Atlas will trade real money on your OKX live account {{uid}}. Trading pauses right after the switch, until you resume it.
sw.f1: For the first 30 days, autonomy stays at 2 or below.
sw.f2: Your live bot capital cap limits every trade.
sw.f3: Every Approve asks you once more before a real order goes out.
sw.many: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.
sw.pre: Atlas’s server found a check that isn’t passing: {{items}}. Fix it on this page, then try again.
sw.failed: Atlas’s server didn’t answer. Nothing was switched. Try again.
sw.toastBody: Trading is paused until you resume it.

dm.title: Switch Atlas back to demo?
dm.text: Open live positions stay on OKX with their stops. Atlas stops managing them until you switch back.
dm.text2: Trading on demo starts paused, until you resume it.

at.failBody: “{{item}}” is back as it was. Atlas’s server didn’t answer.

err.title: Couldn’t load the environment
err.body: Atlas’s server didn’t answer. Check that Atlas is running with ./atlas up, then try again.
